workflows.content:
name: Fixture-mode Pages deployment
on:
  push:
    branches: [paypal-ai]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm test
  deploy:
    needs: test
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: github-pages-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        with:
          artifact_name: github-pages-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

name: Fixture tests

on:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: fixture-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm test

proposed_custody.scope: Evidence-only: ZIP, manifest, read-only trigger audit and native handoff; no product/workflow path modifications, no PR, no default-branch update.
proposed_custody.trigger_analysis: Existing push event is limited to paypal-ai, which this branch does not match. Existing pull_request event is not raised because no PR is created. No create/issues/issue_comment/schedule event is configured. No workflow_dispatch/rerun is called. The new proposed browser workflow exists only inside the ZIP and is not an active workflow file on the custody branch.
proposed_custody.prewrite_requirement: Re-read default ref/tree and all active workflow blobs immediately before mutation; stop if filters or scope differ.

issue_comment.actions_events: No issues/issue_comment workflow in complete current tree
issue_comment.note: No statement is made about unconfigured external applications.
